body: This PR makes a new release of ClimaAtmos and updates the manifest.
title: Release v0.42.19

body:
## Purpose

The end-to-end performance pipeline pins a ClimaCoupler commit from before the coupler moved to Julia 1.13 and CUDA 6 (CliMA/ClimaCoupler.jl#2214), so its AMIP environment resolves CUDA 5.11.3 and GPUCompiler 1.17.1. Under Julia 1.13 that GPU stack compiles the column kernels of the flagship AMIP benchmark with many stack slots and at the register limit, which is why the benchmark has run about 25 times slower since #4944. This PR moves the pin to ClimaCoupler `main` (from `dd16e967` to `ff831888`), whose environment resolves CUDA 6.4.1 and GPUCompiler 2.10.0, the versions of ClimaAtmos's own GPU jobs. It also sets the fallback `BASELINE_SYPD` of the SYPD check to 0.252, the SYPD measured with the new pin in build [511](https://buildkite.com/clima/climaatmos-end-to-end-performance/builds/511).

## Disclosure

This PR and its description were mostly generated using Claude.

## Comparison against main

The PR rows come from a build of the head of this PR, `80aea9d45`, and the `main` rows from the build of `main` at `52dfab8de`, its base.

| Flagship AMIP (A100), wall time per coupling step | 0.326 s | 9.02 s | -96.4% | [511](https://buildkite.com/clima/climaatmos-end-to-end-performance/builds/511), [510](https://buildkite.com/clima/climaatmos-end-to-end-performance/builds/510) |
| Flagship AMIP (A100), compilation time | 21.4 min | 16.6 min | +29.0% | [511](https://buildkite.com/clima/climaatmos-end-to-end-performance/builds/511), [510](https://buildkite.com/clima/climaatmos-end-to-end-performance/builds/510) |
| Flagship AMIP (A100), compilation memory | 289.0 GiB | 264.0 GiB | +9.5% | [511](https://buildkite.com/clima/climaatmos-end-to-end-performance/builds/511), [510](https://buildkite.com/clima/climaatmos-end-to-end-performance/builds/510) |

## Effect of #4953 with the new pin

With the new pin, #4953 lowers the wall time per coupling step from 0.382 s (`main` at `7eacbde07`, its base, in build [480](https://buildkite.com/clima/climaatmos-end-to-end-performance/builds/480)) to 0.322 s (-15.7%, or +18.6% in SYPD).
